D: Peter runs away to the big city and falls in with a gang of animals planning a heist at the farmers market.
P: Serve the snacks when the farmers market heist begins.
S: the farmers market the gang plans to rob
A big platter of strawberries, apples, melon and grapes, the stalls the gang has its eye on.
Barnabas's dried fruit heist at the market
Dried fruit and nuts mixed in a big bowl, the loot Barnabas sends the gang after.
M: the trip to the city of Gloucester

Chicken, leek and carrot pie under golden puff pastry, a proper English city lunch. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, add 1 sliced leek and 2 diced carrots, then 300ml stock thickened with 2 tbsp flour.
W: Moist carrot cake with cream cheese icing, the only cake a rabbit would bake. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 150g brown sugar, cinnamon, 2 eggs, 150ml oil and 3 grated carrots.
K: Cold apple juice over ice with a slice of apple.

s.note: the farmers market the gang plans to rob
s.how: Hull 250g strawberries, slice 2 apples and cut a rockmelon into wedges. Arrange on a big platter with 500g grapes and squeeze over a little lemon to stop the apple browning.

s.note: Barnabas's dried fruit heist at the market
s.how: Tip 200g dried fruit mix and 200g mixed nuts into a bowl with 100g dried apricots and toss together. Set it out before the opening credits.

m.note: the trip to the city of Gloucester
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, add 1 sliced leek and 2 diced carrots, then 300ml stock thickened with 2 tbsp flour. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.how: Mix 200g self-raising flour, 150g brown sugar, cinnamon, 2 eggs, 150ml oil and 3 grated carrots. Bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Ice with 250g cream cheese beaten with 150g icing sugar.

d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in 1.2L cold apple juice and float a thin slice of apple in each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
